full_page.content:
1936, April
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 105 Cont.
Apr. 7th May Morgan - about 40 - operation expected next Monday - gall & apendix
Hatti Jacobs
Maurice Mortier - improving since last Wed. at 4 P.M. - hopeless at that time.
Page 106 Apr. 8th Esther & Adel Jablway - 18 yrs praying for family. So far totally disapointed. He is a mohamidan.
Mrs. Cath. Hall - 30 - very ill - lost baby - has husband and one little boy 7
Annie McCormack - 50 - at Kingston Ont. - Arthritis and broken hip. Joseph Corby - 30 - has wife and four small Ch'n depending. Has been West and all over for asthma - nothing helps - promises daily communion if improved.
Frank Johnson - Ira'cipi .-
Bridget Heborm -
John Katzler - 40 - married 18 yrs to one supposed to be Catholic - once a year to holy Communion - seems has now turned to spiritism, hating husband.
Wm. John Leaden - 30 - Episcopelian - totally blind in one eye and losing sight in other ... Enrolled To-day.
Page 107 Apr. 15 Mrs. Cath. Murphy - 79 - Vericoes ulcers was "hopeless case" some weeks ago. Now ulcers quite healed but from long confinement has a painful sore on heel ...
Lucas Baby
Mrs. Ann Soderlund - about 52 - brain tuomer .... has two daughters twins.
Madeline Kaiser - infected finger since February.
